id: 12_Demonstration of Verification of KVL and KCL for a given DC Circuit Basic Electr
title: 电工实验：基尔霍夫定律（实测演示）（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/12_Demonstration of Verification of KVL and KCL for a given DC Circuit Basic Electr.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/12_Demonstration of Verification of KVL and KCL for a given DC Circuit Basic Electr（国内版）/src.py

points.K15: 换电压重复，有疑问就问
points.S1: 双路电源不随意串并联
points.S2: 万用表换档先移表笔，用完关机

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，台上有稳压电源、三只小灯和电表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench with a dual regulated DC power supply, three small lamps and DC meters, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 上次算好了，今天动手测一测！
overlay: 电工实验：基尔霍夫定律（实测演示）

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着上次的计算纸，对着实验台跃跃欲试
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his calculation sheet from last time and looks eagerly at the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰带着计算结果，来实验室对答案。

shots.scene: 小研指着电源面板上一排旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the row of knobs on the power supply front panel.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把电源认清楚。

shots.scene: 电路图图标：先亮起串联部分，再亮起电压表
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon where the series path lights up first, then the voltmeters light up. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂电路，先接串联，最后并电压表。

shots.scene: 万用表拨到直流电压档，代替三只电压表
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter set to DC voltage replaces three small voltmeter icons that fade out. No people.
shots.narration: 这次用一只万用表直流档代替电压表。

shots.scene: 双路稳压电源，两组输出端各有一个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A dual-channel regulated DC power supply with two sets of output terminals, each with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 这台电源有两路输出，任用一路。

shots.scene: 老周指着两路输出讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the two output channels and explains.
shots.narration: 两路可以串起来升压，本实验用不到。

shots.scene: 电压粗调旋钮和细调旋钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of two voltage knobs on the supply, one large for coarse and one small for fine adjustment. No people.
shots.narration: 粗调旋钮大步调，细调旋钮微调。

shots.scene: 旁边的电流旋钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the current knob beside the voltage knobs. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边这个是电流旋钮。

shots.scene: 手把两个电压旋钮都转到最小
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns both voltage knobs fully counterclockwise to minimum.
shots.narration: 开机前，两个电压旋钮放到最小。

shots.scene: 王老师指着电流旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the current knob and gives instructions.
shots.narration: 电流旋钮按老师要求设好。

shots.scene: 拨钮拨动，显示窗在电压和电流图标间切换
shots.prompt_en: A small toggle switch is flipped and the display window changes between a voltage icon and a current icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这个拨钮切换显示电压还是电流。

shots.scene: 红色正端子和黑色负端子特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a red positive output terminal and a black negative output terminal on the supply. No people.
shots.narration: 输出端分正负，直流不能接反。

shots.scene: 电源总开关处于关闭位置
shots.prompt_en: The main power switch of the supply in the off position. No people.
shots.narration: 接线时，电源总开关一定是关的。

shots.scene: 透明面板上三只小灯，两只并排一只在前
shots.prompt_en: Three small lamps on a clear panel: one in front, two side by side behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 灯2灯3并联，再和灯1串联。

shots.scene: 万用表表笔跨在第一盏灯两端
shots.prompt_en: Multimeter probes placed across the two ends of the first lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 万用表测灯1两端，就是V2。

shots.scene: 表笔跨在并联两灯两端
shots.prompt_en: Multimeter probes placed across the pair of parallel lamps. No people.
shots.narration: 测并联部分两端，就是V3。

shots.scene: 电源显示窗亮着电压图标
shots.prompt_en: The power supply display window lit with a voltage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电源电压V1，直接看电源显示。

shots.scene: 三只直流电流表一字排开
shots.prompt_en: Three DC ammeters with blank dials lined up on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 三只直流电流表测三路电流。

shots.scene: 箭头从电源正极出发，进入第一只电流表正端
shots.prompt_en: An arrow starts at the positive terminal of the supply and enters the plus terminal of the first ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 从电源正极出发，先进电流表正端。

shots.scene: 箭头经过灯1后分成两路，各进一只电流表
shots.prompt_en: The arrow passes through the first lamp, then splits into two paths, each entering an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 过了灯1分两路，各串一只电流表。

shots.scene: 两路分别经过灯2、灯3后汇合，回到负极
shots.prompt_en: The two paths pass through the second and third lamps, join together and return to the negative terminal. No people.
shots.narration: 两灯另一端接在一起，回到负极。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照电路图接线，王老师在旁检查
shots.prompt_en: The young male student connects the wires following a blank diagram while the safety administrator checks beside him.
shots.narration: 接好后请老师检查，形成闭合回路。

shots.scene: 阿杰打开电源，转粗调再转细调
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches on the supply and turns the coarse knob, then the fine knob.
shots.narration: 打开电源，粗调细调到设定电压。

shots.scene: 万用表旋钮停在直流档，交流档图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter dial resting on DC voltage with a green check, and an AC voltage icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 万用表要拨直流档，别拨交流档。

shots.scene: 小研测灯1两端电压，阿杰记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student measures across the first lamp with the multimeter while the young male student writes on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 先测灯1两端，记下V2。

shots.scene: 小研再测并联部分电压
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the probes to measure across the two parallel lamps.
shots.narration: 再测并联部分，记下V3。

shots.scene: 两段电压柱叠起来，和电源电压柱几乎一样高
shots.prompt_en: Two voltage bars stacked together are almost as tall as the source voltage bar, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 两段相加，和电源电压基本相等。

shots.scene: 阿杰慢慢转电源旋钮，眼睛盯着第一只电流表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slowly turns the supply knob while watching the first ammeter.
shots.narration: 调电源，让干路电流到一个值。

shots.scene: 表盘下排刻度高亮
shots.prompt_en: A meter dial with its lower scale row highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 用小量程，就读下排刻度。

shots.scene: 两只支路电流表读数被记下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the two branch ammeters and writes the values on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 再读两条支路的电流。

shots.scene: 两个支路箭头合起来约等于干路箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two branch arrows combine to nearly equal the main arrow, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 两路相加，约等于干路电流。

shots.scene: 天平稍微倾斜，旁边一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale tilted very slightly, with a magnifying glass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 元件和电表都有误差，差一点正常。

shots.section_title: 换电压重复，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 电压旋钮转到另一位置，再测一组
shots.prompt_en: The voltage knob is turned to another position and the group takes another set of readings.
shots.narration: 换几个电压，重复测几组。
overlay: 换电压重复，有疑问就问

shots.section_title: 换电压重复，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 两张表格并排：理论值和实测值
shots.prompt_en: Two blank tables side by side, one with a calculator icon and one with a meter icon, both checked. No people.
shots.narration: 理论和实测都做完，才算完成。

shots.section_title: 换电压重复，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，老周回答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand and the older man answers.
shots.narration: 对照教材复习，有疑问就问。

shots.section_title: 双路电源不随意串并联
shots.scene: 两路电源用导线串起来的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two power supply channels joined in series by a jumper wire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 两路电源不要自己随意串联并联。
overlay: 双路电源不随意串并联

shots.section_title: 双路电源不随意串并联
shots.scene: 串联后电压过高，小灯泡烧坏的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small lamp burning out from too high a voltage. No people.
shots.narration: 串联后电压升高，元件和电表会烧坏。

shots.section_title: 双路电源不随意串并联
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白说明书讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank instruction manual and explains to the students.
shots.narration: 确需串并联，按说明书和老师指导。

shots.section_title: 万用表换档先移表笔，用完关机
shots.scene: 表笔还接在电路上就转档位的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand turning a multimeter dial while the probes are still on a live circuit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 换档前，表笔先离开电路。
overlay: 万用表换档先移表笔，用完关机

shots.section_title: 万用表换档先移表笔，用完关机
shots.scene: 小研先抬起表笔，再转旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the probes away from the circuit, then turns the multimeter dial.
shots.narration: 换好档、核对好，再去测。

shots.section_title: 万用表换档先移表笔，用完关机
shots.scene: 万用表旋钮转到关机位置
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter dial turned to the off position; the display is dark. No people.
shots.narration: 用完拨到关机档，防止下次误测。

shots.scene: 电源面板上两个指示灯，一个亮绿，一个亮红
shots.prompt_en: Two indicator lights on the supply panel, one glowing green and one glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 电源有恒压和恒流两个指示灯。

shots.scene: 红色恒流灯亮起，旁边一个短路图标
shots.prompt_en: The red constant-current indicator lights up next to a short-circuit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 恒流灯亮，可能是短路或接错了。

shots.scene: 阿杰立即关电源，和小研检查导线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student immediately switches off the supply and checks the wires with the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 先断电，查清原因再通电。

shots.scene: 电源旋钮、正负端子、闭合回路三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: knobs at minimum, plus and minus terminals, and a closed circuit loop. No people.
shots.narration: 旋钮放好，正负分清，接成闭合回路。

shots.scene: 两个约等式都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two approximate equation icons, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 实测电压电流，两条定律都成立。

shots.scene: 双路电源、关机的万用表、恒流灯三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dual power supply, a multimeter switched off, and a red indicator light. No people.
shots.narration: 电源不乱串，换档移表笔，红灯就断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好电源的实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the bench with the power supply switched off.
shots.narration: 定律验证成功，下次见！
